title: Legacy program money routed through FFRDCs and bales of cash
summary: UAPGerb tells of Legacy program money routed through FFRDCs and bales of cash, about present at DoD labs, MRTFBs, Crystal City, Arlington, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: DoD labs, MRTFBs, Crystal City, Arlington

tellings.quote: And I really think the amount of money that's moved can't really be tracked because I myself have talked to witnesses who have seen cash moved like physical bales of cash taken to locations.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, talking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2025, says the money behind a so-called legacy program, a secret effort said to handle craft that are not human-made, moves through hidden channels. In this telling it goes through federally funded research centers (privately run labs paid for by the government), Defense Department labs and military test ranges, and offices in Crystal City and Arlington, near the Pentagon in Virginia. UAPGerb says he has talked to witnesses who saw physical bales of cash taken to locations, which, if true, would mean nobody could really track how much is spent.
